'''Cobble Stone Square''' was a plaza in [[Dorthus Tal City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]]. It was one of the more notable places of interest in the city.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />
